subject: reasoning
question: Length of 5 rectangles J, K, L, M and N is compared. Length of no two rectangles is same. Length of K is less than only three rectangles. Length of no rectangle is less than M. Length of L is not more than N but more than J. Length of which rectangle is maximum?
